messages:
sam_oncall: Pager cleared — order-processor pool OOM at 2025-05-10 08:12 UTC. We mitigated by scale-up and restarting the service. Suspect batching memory leak.
incident-bot: Incident 20250510-OP-17 created. Severity: P2. Page started 08:04 UTC, page cleared 08:19 UTC.
maria_sre: Thanks — can someone own the post-incident writeup and facilitation? I can take notes but running high on my plate today.
ron_prod: I can facilitate if needed, but timezone heads-up: PST afternoon is fine until 17:00.
alex_support: Requesting that we include the affected customer set and the public status timeline in the postmortem. I have the customer impact notes.
jamie_eng: I'll own the initial RCA draft (root cause + mem profile), can do the perf trace export and attach.
sam_oncall: @ron_prod that would be 🔥. If you can facilitate, please propose 2 time blocks for 30–45min this week. Need to include SRE, Eng owner, Support, Product.
ron_prod: Proposing Thu 2025-05-15 16:00-16:45 UTC or Fri 2025-05-16 09:00-09:45 UTC. Which works?
maria_sre: Thu 16:00 UTC conflicts for me (oncall follow-up). Fri 09:00 UTC works.
aj_support: Fri 09:00 UTC is awkward for APAC. Can we do Fri 14:00 UTC instead? Customer AM hours are small.
jamie_eng: 14:00 UTC okay for me. Ron, can you do 14:00 instead of 09:00?
ron_prod: I can move things, OK for Fri 14:00 UTC then. I'll block 45m and create calendar invite.
incident-bot: New calendar event created: "Post-incident review — order-processor OOM" Fri 2025-05-16 14:00 UTC. Attendees: ron_prod, maria_sre, jamie_eng, alex_support, sam_oncall, product_lead.
sam_oncall: Agenda I suggest:
- 5m intro & timeline
- 15m technical RCA (Jamie)
- 10m customer impact & comms (Alex)
- 10m action items and rollouts
- 5m follow-ups and owners
ron_prod: Also add: decision on hotfix vs mitigation plan and owner for regression test.
maria_sre: Pre-read asks:
- Jamie: perf traces + heap diff
- Alex: customer impact timeline + support tickets
- Sam: incident timeline and mitigation commands run
Please drop into the doc by EOD Thu.
aj_support: I'll attach the affected customer list and CS notes to the doc.
jamie_eng: Uploading perf trace export to the doc now. Will add a short summary of suspected leak area.
product_lead: Can we invite @legal for a quick 10m at the end if the customer is enterprise? Might need contract check.
alex_support: Yes, one customer flagged is enterprise; legal consult appreciated.
ron_prod: OK adding legal as optional attendee and observers channel. Also inviting infra_ops for follow-up.
sam_oncall: Action items so far (captured):
- [Jamie] RCA draft + traces — due Thu EOD
- [Alex] Customer timeline + tickets — due Thu EOD
- [Maria] Incident timeline + mitigation runbook update — due Fri before meeting
- [Ron] Facilitate meeting + create follow-up JIRA epic — due Mon
- [Sam] Postmortem template + links — due Thu
Please ack your lines.
jamie_eng: ack
alex_support: ack
maria_sre: ack
ron_prod: ack
sam_oncall: quick note: we'll also include the paging noise analysis — who paged and what alert thresholds fired. @monitoring-bot can you attach alert graph?
monitoring-bot: Attached alert graph for order-processor CPU/mem spikes 07:50–08:30 UTC.
ron_prod: Thanks all — I'll send the final invite and the doc link. If anyone can't make Fri 14:00 UTC, please propose alternative within 24h.
jen_ops: I might be out Fri 14:00 UTC, adding myself as reviewer asynchronously.
sam_oncall: Closing: meeting scheduled Fri 2025-05-16 14:00 UTC. Postmortem doc link: https://confluence.redwood/order-processor/postincident-20250510
